propositions: Three near-identical walkers (_has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, find_replacement) discover ticket replacement links by iterating deps for duplicates then find_inbound_relationships for supersedes, differing only in liveness check and return type.

Bug frolicky-dependable-peccary arose from verdict consulting only find_replacement while the not_a_bug exemption rule lived in a separate comment, and DISPOSITION_CLASSES equality was enforced only by a test assertion.

The replacement-link walk (find_inbound_relationships combined with supersedes string) must appear exactly once in src/rebar, only in close_disposition.py, with a reasoned escape marker to prevent silent re-introduction.
_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES must be structurally derived from (same object as) close_disposition.DISPOSITION_CLASSES so the two cannot drift.

The three walkers are not interchangeable: find_replacement guards on DISPOSITION_CLASSES only, _has_live_replacement_link additionally narrows non-bugs to ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES (fc20), and _recorded_replacement_target has no guard and continues to inbound after subject reduce failure where others return early.
Monkeypatch seams (_has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, find_replacement) must retain exact names and signatures as specified because tests patch them by name with raising=False.
